title: RAG-RL: Advancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via RL and Curriculum Learning
authors: Jerry Huang; Siddarth Madala; Risham Sidhu; Cheng Niu; Hao Peng; Julia Hockenmaier; Tong Zhang
why_relevant: RAG-RL trains the generator to identify and cite relevant passages among distractors, directly addressing robustness to imperfect retrieval and irrelevant contexts via RL and curriculum learning.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving generation under distractors rather than adversarial or conflict settings; evaluation limited to multi-hop QA.
